title: Text Editor, Browser Developer Tools, Save amasung Refresh touba
learningObjectives: Text Editor-গী মখলদা মশক তৌবা মরম অমসুং Source Code-দা plain Text ওইনা ইশিনবা অমসুং শেমদোকপদা মদু করম্না শিজিন্নবগে হায়বা তাকপা ঙমগনি।
Code Editor অমসুং basic Text Editor অনীগী মরক্তা লৈবা খেন্নবশিং অমসুং Syntax Highlighting, Line Numbers, Search, Auto-Indentationগুম্বা featureশিং খঙবা ঙমগনি।
মরু ওইবা File Name, Folder অমসুং Extension খল্লগা Project File Create, Open, Rename, Save তৌবা অমসুং ভুল Location-দা Save তৌবা থিংবা ঙমগনি।
Edit–Save–Refresh মথৌগী লমচৎ তাক্লগা Browser-দা অনৌবা change উনবা মমাংদা Source File Save তৌবা করিগী দরকার ওইবগে তাকপা ঙমগনি।
Local HTML File Browser-দা হাংদুনা Refresh তৌরগা উবা Content অসি Save তৌরবা Source Code-গা চান্নব্রা যাচাই তৌবা ঙমগনি।
Browser Developer Tools হাংদুনা Page-গী live Document Structure অমসুং select তৌরবা Element-গী Styles শেমদোক্নবা Elements panel খঙবা ঙমগনি।
Console panel-দা JavaScript Messages, Warnings, Errors উবা অমসুং Error Text, Source File Name, Line Numberগুম্বা clueশিং খঙবা ঙমগনি।
Text Editor-দা original Source File শেমদোকপা অমসুং Developer Tools-দা temporary Live Changes তৌবগী খেন্নবশিং তাকপা; temporary changeশিং Source File-দা auto-save তৌদে হায়বা খঙবা ঙমগনি।
Save তৌদবা Edit, ভুল Browser Tab Refresh, ভুল File হাংবা, Syntax Errors, Browser Cache-গী মরমদা change উতদবা মখলগী সমস্যা খঙবা ঙমগনি।
File অমসুং Path verify তৌবা, change Save তৌবা, correct Page Refresh তৌবা, Elements অমসুং Console check তৌবা, Source correct তৌদুনা অমুক Test তৌবা troubleshooting লমচৎ শিজিন্নবা ঙমগনি।

understand.concept: Text Editor asi Code adu plain Text oina iriba amasung hen-gat-han-gat touba Tool-ni. Browser-na Code adugi matung-inna Web Page utli. Browser-gi Developer Tools-na Page-gi structure, apply touba CSS Styles amasung JavaScript Errors yengsinba mateng pangi. Code-da change touba matungda File Save tou. Aduga Browser Page Refresh touba matungda Save toukhraba anouba change load tou-i.
understand.whyItMatters: Edit → Save → Refresh gi order adu matik chana sijinnabada ahanba amasung anouba Code-gi maramda confusion kaya hanthagani. Problem ama thoklabadi guess touba nattana Developer Tools-da udriba information yengsinba ngamgani.
understand.history: Web development-gi ahanba matamda Page edit touba amasung yengba gi thakta tool khudingmak separate oina sijinnarammi. Matungda Browser-singda Developer Tools yaohanbani. Masigi matengna Page Structure, Styles, Network Activity amasung Errors yengsinba ngamkhi.
understand.analogy: Text Editor-da Code iriba asi Notebook-da instruction iriba ga mari lei. Save touba matamda instruction adu save o-i; Browser-na result adu utli. Developer Tools asi result adu manungda yengsinba window ama oina khallou.
understand.analogyLimit: Browser-na note khaktang read toude. Mahakna HTML Parse tou-i, CSS calculate tou-i amasung JavaScript execute tou-i. Developer Tools-da temporary edit touba adu original File-da automatic oina Save touraroidabani.

explain.narrative: Text Editor-da HTML File ama hangdok-u amasung madu-gi Heading change tou. File Save tou. Aduga Browser-da File hangdok-u amasung Page Refresh tou; anouba Heading adu uroi. Developer Tools hangdok-u amasung Elements panel-da HTML Structure yeng-u. Console-da JavaScript Messages amasung Errors u-i. Error ama thoklabadi ahanba line, File Name amasung Line Number note tou. Developer Tools-gi Live Edit asi temporary-ni; permanent change tou naba Source File change touga Save tou.

examples.code:
Welcome to My Website

I am learning web development.
examples.explanation: Ahanbada Source File-gi change adu Save tou. Matungda Browser Page Refresh touba matamda anouba change load tou-i.
examples.expectedOutput: Browser-இல் Save செய்த புதிய Heading தெரியும்.

practise.guidedTask: `index.html`-gi Paragraph ama change tou, Save touga Refresh tou. Matungda Developer Tools-gi Elements panel-da Paragraph adu thiba tou.
practise.independentTask: Practice Page-da purposely error ama amatta puthok-u. Browser Refresh touga Console-da Error yeng-u. Source File-da error adu sudhar tou, Save touga amuk Refresh tou.
hints: Ahanbada Source File Save toukhrabani haiba confirm tou.
Elements-na Document Structure utli; Console-na Messages amasung Errors utli.
Developer Tools-da touba temporary Edits adu original Source File-da automatic Save toude.
Save செய்த பிறகும் பழைய Page தெரிந்தால் சாதாரண Refresh செய்யுங்கள்; தேவைப்பட்டால் Cache-ஐச் சரிபாருங்கள்.
